import.title: Import original assets
import.text: If you own Master of Orion (1993), pick its .LBX files (or the whole game folder). They are converted to PNG and JSON inside your browser and stored only on this device: nothing is uploaded.
The Classic theme then shows the original planet pictures and race portraits. The game is fully playable without them.
mods.title: Mods
mods.text: A mod is a folder with any of: mod.json (name, description, base theme), text/en.json (replaces any text of the game), rules.json (game numbers and ship designs) and images/*.png (for example images/site/terran.png, images/army.png, images/race/0.png, images/map/background.png).
See docs/MODDING.md in the repository for the full list.

help.lines: Grow your empire from a single planet. Every colony splits its production between five sliders: SHIP builds the selected design, DEFENSE builds missile bases and shields, INDUSTRY builds factories, ECOLOGY cleans pollution and grows population, TECHNOLOGY funds research.
Select your colony ship in orbit, press Send fleet and click a planet inside the dashed range circles. Colony ships settle automatically on arrival.
Scouts explore stars. Research Planetology to settle hostile planets, Propulsion for range and speed, Construction for cheaper factories and ships, Weapons and Force Fields for combat.
To conquer a planet, win the battle in its orbit (destroying its missile bases), then send transports from a nearby colony. Bombers destroy population and factories.
The Guardian protects Orion. Destroy it and colonize Orion for a big research bonus. Eliminate every rival to win.
